title: The Peasant in Heaven

full_text:
A poor, honest peasant arrived at the pearly gates of heaven on the very same morning as a wealthy, celebrated nobleman. When the nobleman approached, heavenly trumpets sounded, angels sang glorious hymns, and celestial gates swung wide in grand celebration.

The peasant stepped forward next, but he was admitted quietly, with gentle smiles from the gatekeeper but without brass horns or grand pageantry. The peasant stood softly in the heavenly courtyard, feeling a brief tremor of worldly doubt, wondering why rich lords were heralded with such thunder while humble plowmen entered in silence.

Saint Peter walked over to him, resting a warm, benevolent hand upon his shoulder. "My son," whispered Peter, "do not misunderstand what you have witnessed. Poor, honest peasants like yourself enter the kingdom of heaven every hour of every day; your steadfast goodness is familiar and beloved in our midst. But a wealthy lord who manages to live righteously, resist greed, and cross this threshold is so rare an arrival that all heaven rejoices when one is saved!"

Hearing this, the peasant chuckled with warm delight, understanding the divine humor and justice, and strolled happily into paradise to enjoy unending peace.
moral: True heavenly celebration welcomes every soul according to the rarity and quiet trials of its journey.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Peasant in Heaven"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
